text:
nate: heads up — found kv-cache leak causing sporadic embed misses. cutting an emergency patch v2.3.9. target EU change window 01:30-02:30 UTC. asking for expedited approvals to skip canary; errors impacting a few paying customers now. details in confluence: https://confluence/release/v2.3.9 (root)
deploybot: Deploybot: preflight checks OK. unit + integration tests green. Canary-skip requires 2 release:approve reactions.
lyla: can we do a quick smoke in staging then pin? if skip canary, we need clear rollback steps.
nate: plan: rolling deploy to eu-west1 only, phased 20/60/100. rollback = pin last-known-good sha def456 + traffic cut. no schema changes. auto-rollback threshold: 3m error rate > 1.5%. snippet below.
nate: ```sh
# rollback
kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=image:def456 -n prod-eu
# force deploybot rollback
deploybot rollback --thread 7012345678 --reason "auto-rollback"
```
ops-oncall: capacity checked in eu-west1, spare nodes available, i'll stay on the thread and monitor. +1
gerard: +1 from me for skip if ops and oncall are watching. please add one-line release note for support.
lyla: addendum — monitor kv-hit-rate and embed-404s, call rollback immediately if kv-miss > baseline*2.
gerard: release note draft: "v2.3.9 — emergency fix for kv-cache leak affecting embeddings; rolling EU 01:30-02:30 UTC; no schema changes." I'll ping product and support after rollout.
deploybot: Deploybot: Approval count: 3 (nate, gerard, ops-oncall). Initiating rollout in 2m. logs: https://deploylogs/7012345678
deploybot: Phase 1 (20%) -> OK (error-rate steady). Phase 2 (60%) -> OK (latency normal). Phase 3 (100%) -> Completed.
lyla: running sanity probes: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://api.eu1.redwood/sanity -d '{}'` -> 200s. kv-hit-rate up ~90% vs pre-patch.
ops-oncall: observed no crash loops. keeping oncall pager open.
ngerard: thanks all — closing rollout and filing release notes. :tada:
thread_summary: Emergency v2.3.9 hotfix for kv-cache leak in EU; expedited skip-canary approvals obtained (nate, gerard, ops-oncall). Phased rollout completed with metrics improved; rollback plan pinned to def456 if thresholds hit; support/product notified.
